card.name: Reverse direction in drug interaction statements
card.fires_on: Words in drug interaction sentences where the effect is turned around, such as 'other drugs may alter the concentrations' of the main drug, or 'effect of X on' another drug.

modes.label: Reversed alteration clause
modes.description: The word 'concentrations' or 'drugs' in the stock phrase saying other drugs may alter the concentrations of the labeled drug.
modes.example: other drugs can alter the concentrations of other drugs and other drugs may alter the<< concentrations>> of darunavir.

modes.label: Effect of X on Y
modes.description: A linking word such as 'on' or 'of' where the effect of one drug on another's levels is being described in reverse.
modes.example: The effect of theophylline<< on>> the pharmacokinetics of citalop

card.writes: Little clear output effect; the promoted tokens hint at a switch of subject and object ("you to me", "in reverse").
card.plain: It fires where a label says the effect also runs the other way, from the other drug back onto the labeled drug.
